local: Ton front est ceint de fleurons glorieux!
english: True patriot love in all of us command.

local: Car ton bras sait porter l'épée,
english: With glowing hearts we see thee rise,
The True North strong and free!
O [[Canada]], we stand on guard for thee.

local: Et ta valeur, de foi trempée,
Protégera nos foyers et nos droits.
english: God keep our land glorious and free!
O [[Canada]], we stand on guard for thee.
